probe: M022 T008 — the ISOLATED→MAIN pick hop and the drawn rect, end to end
page: http://localhost:4222/ — spikes/ng222-app, the counter fixture in its development configuration (Angular 22.2.2), served by control-angular-dev-app and loaded in a new tab the probe opens and closes

extension.declaration: observer-filter.js, overlay-geometry.js, overlay.js at document_start (ISOLATED), relay.js at document_idle (ISOLATED), agent-main.js at document_idle (MAIN)
extension.loadedBy: control-ai-browsers up chrome-stable-nano, after the declaration change; content scripts are read once at extension load, so the instance was restarted for this reading

dispatch.emittedBy: extension/overlay.js, on the element document.elementFromPoint answered for the click's point

answer.readBy: extension/agent-main.js handlePick, the capture listener registered on globalThis
answer.arrivedMs: under the 1500 ms bound; no `unavailable` state was emitted on this reading

whyEventTargetIsProven: The MAIN-world listener is handed the event and calls `handlePick`, which reads `event.target` and never `event.detail`. The descriptor it answered names the tag of the element the click landed on (`p`), and the same descriptor resolves to that element's owning component (`app-counter`, `_Counter`, path `_Counter → _App`) — a payload object could carry neither, and the pick event's `detail` was observed as `null` from a capture listener beside the shipped one. The target was also observed as an element node (`nodeType === 1`) by that listener, so what crossed the world boundary was a DOM node, not a serialized copy of one.

hitTest.note: The hover path resolved the candidate through document.elementFromPoint at the pointer's point; the host is pointer-events: none, so the answer is the page element on this profile, exactly as T002 measured. A hit that returned the host would be the tool and not a candidate, and the picker never depends on an engine retargeting an inner node of the closed root (reliesOnEngineRetargeting: false).

lockedAtTheTop.label: transform: translate(8px, 40.2857px) — below the box, inside the viewport
lockedAtTheTop.measuredBy: DOM.getBoxModel through DOM.getDocument({pierce: true}), which reaches the closed root: border box left 8.571, top 16.571, width 1071, height 18

scrolledToTheBottom.label: transform: translate(8px, 0px) — the box is above the viewport, the label is clamped to its top edge
scrolledToTheBottom.measuredBy: DOM.getBoxModel: label border box left 14, top 2, width 184, height 21 — inside the viewport

drawnBox.statement: The drawn box is the getBoundingClientRect() reading verbatim, in CSS pixels, at a device pixel ratio of 1.75 and after a 5203 px scroll: no ratio is multiplied in and no matrix is rebuilt, and the label stays inside the viewport at the extreme scroll position.

method.arm: the probe dispatched CustomEvent('angular-ai:picker-command', { detail: { action: 'arm' } }) on window, the event the relay re-dispatches for the panel's command
method.hover: a pointermove with the picked element's own centre as clientX/clientY; the overlay resolves the candidate with document.elementFromPoint
method.lock: a click dispatched on the element elementFromPoint answers for that point, so the overlay's capture listener locks the pick and dispatches angular-ai:pick on that element
method.answer: the probe awaited the angular-ai:picked event on window, the page realm's own answer; it timed out at 6000 ms and did not
method.drawing: read out of the closed root over CDP: DOM.getDocument({ depth: -1, pierce: true }) then DOM.getBoxModel and DOM.getOuterHTML for the two nodes the picker created
method.cleanup: the tab the probe opened is closed by the control script's tab wrapper; the fixture server and the instance are the shared ones
method.picked element: the first element under app-root whose own centre hit-tests to itself or to one of its children, so the click and the picker cannot disagree about the point

verdict: measured: on chrome-stable-nano (Chrome 156) a click on a page element crosses from the isolated-world overlay to the MAIN-world listener as a DOM node, the listener reads event.target and never a payload object, and the page realm answers with the resolved descriptor for that element (elementTag p, componentName app-counter, className _Counter); the drawn box equals getBoundingClientRect() verbatim at devicePixelRatio 1.75 and after a 5203 px scroll, with the label clamped inside the viewport
